 if size s=32 then Some (E (Array32.of_list W8.zero s)) else
 if size s=1153 /\ nth W8.zero s 0=W8.zero then
   Some (F (peel1153 (Array1153.of_list W8.zero s))) else
 if size s=1153 /\ nth W8.zero s 0=W8.one then
   Some (G (peel1153 (Array1153.of_list W8.zero s))) else
 if size s=129 /\ nth W8.zero s 0=W8.of_int 2 then
   Some (H (peel_h (Array129.of_list W8.zero s))) else None.

rules.fixed_array_copy: 3*N = allocation N + read N + write N; actual source boundaries may be conservatively overcharged
rules.persistent_list: head/behead/spine bindings are constant; new cons copies fixed payload and allocates two node fields; no full list clone
rules.array_of_list: <=5+10*N+N*(10*N+8); N in {32,129,1153}; no opaque unit cost
rules.raw_decode: at most two decode_typed invocations; each up to four list-size scans; typed construction maxN1153
rules.raw_prefix: to_list224+take at most224: <=32+24*224; valid output zero still performs full backend and H record
rules.ideal_rom: ROE/F/G/H and RawXOFStreams extension maps are explicit ideal lookup/sample boundaries, not concrete FMap cost
rules.counter: new RT ledger computation is ghost; original HistTable/HistLookup procedure counters are included in the block prices
rules.int: unit-cost unbounded EC integer control operations; no bit-complexity claim
rules.forward_G: at most six forwarding/call boundaries: each <=3*(1152+192)+8, plus each returned-array binding3*192, ideal endpoint1; list cons separate
rules.visit_bound: 65536 bounds each independently expanded visit block: maximum is lookup58897; candidate and comparator bodies are separate
rules.sample_key32: actual fixed uniform32 sampler source expansion, 194 units inline; setup allocation/call copies additionally bounded

lower annotation and final bound together
omit FOHashG or ACWC2GPrepare wrapper boundary
omit FOGHash or SOTPEncode wrapper boundary
claim value projection proves equal wrapper cost

numeric_lowering.token_rule: one unit per lexical source token is a conservative upper bound for each permitted scalar/guard/call-frame/return instruction; unknown nonprimitive operators are rejected or expanded by a separate rule
numeric_lowering.array_rule: each syntactic reference to a typed finite-array value is conservatively charged 3*N cells, plus entry/result boundaries; even read-only references may be overcharged
numeric_lowering.initializer_rule: known zero/default initializers cost <=5*N+8, head witness reserves fixed1152 cells; this bound is conservative for the persistent array representation
numeric_lowering.loop_rule: fixed includes initial guard once; per_visit includes guard plus body; nested loops not permitted in these phase procedures
numeric_lowering.cons_rule: payload/node allocation charged separately via pc_cons, all reference-copy overcharges retained
numeric_lowering.side_condition: these numeric local bounds exclude the body costs of explicitly mapped calls; those are recursively composed or charged to verified kernel/comparator/idealROM buckets
